text: The Harrow Foundation provides annual grants to rural schools.
The Harrow Foundation has responsibility for reviewing rural schools.
The Aldgate Trust transfers surplus equipment to city clinics.
The Aldgate Trust has responsibility for inspecting city clinics.
The Relief Agency gives emergency funds to flood victims.
The Relief Agency has a duty to register flood victims.
The Grants Committee awards travel stipends to junior researchers.
The Grants Committee has a duty to evaluate junior researchers.
The Field Cooperative supplies seed loans to member farms.
The Field Cooperative has the right to audit member farms.
The Science Endowment donates laboratory instruments to the university.
The Science Endowment has the right to inspect the university.
The Health Board provides mobile clinics to remote districts.
The Health Board has authority to close remote districts.
The Interior Ministry donates relief convoys to border towns.
The Interior Ministry has authority to evacuate border towns.
